history.period: CONFLICT (verify): founded 1933 AD per gujuland.com and travel guides, but the temple trust's own site (panchnath.in) says the temple is ~150 years old (~1870s)
history.summary: One of the oldest Shiva temples of Rajkot, at Limda Chowk / Panchnath Plot near Shastri Maidan. The complex holds many mini-shrines in its hall (Adi Shankaracharya, Radha-Krishna, Ram Darbar, Satyanarayan Dev, Annapurna, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Shitala Mata, Kalika Mata, Jalaram Bapa, Gayatri Mata, Aashapura Mata, Puneet Maharaj, Amba Mata, Guru Dattatreya, plus Ganesh and Hanuman flanking the entrance) and a wish-fulfilling tree in the courtyard. Thousands visit daily; Mondays and the month of Shravan are the busiest. The managing trust is known for charitable work: help with medical tests and treatment for the poor, feeding the poor, elderly, orphans and the sick, and a 'Chan for pakshi' scholarship program. Note: a Justdial listing also places it on Kalavad Road - same temple, verify exact approach.

name: Shree Panchnath Mahadev Mandir
town_description: Rajkot is the fourth-largest city of Gujarat and a major commercial, industrial and educational hub of the Saurashtra region. Once the capital of the princely state of Rajkot and an administrative centre of the Saurashtra region, it is also the city where Mahatma Gandhi spent his early years. The city is well connected by air (Rajkot International Airport at Hirasar), rail (Rajkot Junction) and road (NH-27).

travel.airport: Rajkot International Airport ~25-30 km (verify); old Civil Airport closer (verify).
travel.road: Limda Chowk is in the city centre; reachable by city buses, auto-rickshaws and taxis.

visitor_information.best_time: Shravan month (July-August) for special pujas; Mondays are busy.
